steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render bk2/bundle P bk2_out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i bk2_out.mp4 -i bk2/mixm.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest bk2_film.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i bk2_film.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 27 -c:a aac -b:a 128k bk2_720.mp4 && ls -l bk2_film.mp4 bk2_720.mp4 > bk2_done.txt; cat bk2_done.txt
